name: Blue
source: A veteran agent, Blue has survived plenty of scrapes thanks to his abilities of clairvoyance. A crack shot with the revolver and a skilled detective, Blue has worked alone ever since leaving his old partner, Red. His casual personality hides a powerful sense of duty, and rumor has it that he used to be an Enforcer.
